market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Iran conflict-driven oil spike and bond selloff. Yields at 2008 highs pressure equities, especially rate-sensitive growth. Energy outperforms; tech mixed on AI ROI scrutiny. Expect volatility in Q4 as ECB hikes and Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks play out. Gold paradoxically weak on yield dominance. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, risk-off bias with energy as relative outperformer.
market_outlook.long_term: Venezuela energy reopening adds structural supply overhang capping oil upside beyond 2027. AI capex cycle transitions from buildout to ROI phase, favoring disciplined spenders. Apple/Ternus AI strategy and $10T company milestone (early 2028) drive mega-cap narrative. India capital flows and EM integration continue. Dividend growers and quality compounders benefit from higher-for-longer rate environment. 6-12 month outlook: gradual stabilization if Iran de-escalates; structural AI and energy transition themes persist.
